newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MAY RETAIL SALES UP 4.1 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MAY RETAIL SALES UP 4.1 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The volume of Finnish retail sales rose 4.1 percent year-on-year in May, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
The volume of wholesales in May rose 5.0 percent year-on-year, SF said.
In wholesales, all subsectors posted higher sales volumes than in May last year, SF said.
Car and raw material wholesales increased most, both by 11 percent year-on-year.
Retail sales of books and shoes rose more than 11 percent compared to May last year. Department store sales increased five percent and car retailing rose six percent, SF said.
The boom in retail sales of hardware and construction materials slowed to a rise of six percent in May -- the lowest yr/yr gain in any month so far this year, it said.
